additional_info.subject: 0448301 - ID0448301-DC/Si-D/SA-[MP/RD 170003088] Charger is offline CRM:00472000419
additional_info.body:
Hello Islam,
From today's intervention, the charger has showing offline from our Siemens backend.
Tested the connectivity to  your backend and there was connection and SIM card had internet access.
Doing the same test to our Siemens router and the SIM didn't had internet connection. After replacing the SIM card, the charger became available in our Siemens backend.
Both outlets were operational.
We also tried to update the charger via USB but was not possible. We couldn't flash the image properly on USB stick.
Since the charger is again operacional, I will proceed to close this ticket.
With best regards,
Joao Francisco Louro Cardoso
